info.title: Tahsil API
info.description: The Tahsil API manages the catalog, customers, checkout sessions, subscriptions, invoices, payments and refunds of a Tahsil installation. Calls take an API key as a bearer token, carrying the permission each operation names; `ths_test_` keys reach a Test mode installation and `ths_live_` keys a Live one. Errors are RFC 9457 problem details with a stable, machine-readable `code` and a `traceId`.

id.description: The API key, administrator subject or customer ID; `null` for the system.

ActorResponse.description: Who did something: an API key, an administrator, a customer on a hosted page, or Tahsil itself.

ApiKeyResponse.description: An API key, without its secret. `DisplayPrefix` is the start of the secret, to recognize the key by.

AuditEventResponse.description:
An action recorded in the audit trail. `action` reads `resource.past_tense_verb`, such as
`api_key.revoked`. People are referenced by ID only, so the trail outlives their personal data.

permissions.description: The permissions the key may use; its creator must hold them.

expiresAt.description: When the key stops working; it does not expire when omitted.

amount.description: Minor units: positive gives the customer credit, negative adds to what they owe.

description.description: Why the balance changes, such as `Goodwill credit`.

credentials.description: The provider's credential fields. Stored encrypted and never returned.

settings.description: The provider's setting fields, as strings, numbers or booleans.

externalId.description: The application's own ID for the customer, unique; most applications address customers by it.

name.description: A person's full name or a company's legal name.

phone.description: Stored in E.164 when it reads as a phone number.

taxId.description: For Turkey: a TCKN for individuals, a VKN (or the owner's TCKN) for companies. Stored encrypted.

locale.description: `tr` or `en`; the installation's default when omitted.

CreatedApiKeyResponse.description: A new API key with its secret `Key`, which is shown only this once. Callers send it as `Authorization: Bearer ths_…`.

CreatedWebhookEndpointResponse.description: A new endpoint and its signing secret, which is shown only now.

price.description: A one-time price in the currency, by ID or lookup key; or give a description and a unit amount.

unitAmount.description: Minor units, negative for a credit; for items without a price.

taxRate.description: For items without a price: a tax rate by ID or key.

daysUntilDue.description: For `send_invoice`: days from finalization to the due date; `Tahsil:Invoices:DefaultDaysUntilDue` when omitted.

includePendingItems.description: Adds the customer's pending items in the invoice's currency that belong to no subscription.

uniqueProperty.description: For `unique_count`: the event property whose distinct values are counted.

key.description: A unique lookup key, such as `pro-monthly-try`.

transferKey.description: Moves string? CreatePriceRequest.Key from the price that holds it to this one.

unitAmount.description: In minor units, such as 29900 for ₺299.00.

unitAmountDecimal.description: Fractional minor units, for metered prices below one minor unit.

meter.description: The meter's ID or key, for metered prices.

taxRate.description: The tax rate's ID or key; untaxed when omitted.

kimlikPlan.description: The key of the Kimlik plan a subscription to this product grants.

amount.description: Minor units; what is left to refund of the payment when omitted.

card.description: A simulator test card number, such as `4242424242424242`.

expYear.description: Four years from now when omitted.

CreateSimulatorPaymentMethodRequest.description: Test mode only: a saved simulator card for a customer, without a browser (SIM-7).

percentage.description: Between 0 and 100, with up to four decimals, such as 20.

inclusive.description: Whether prices using the rate include the tax.

url.description: An HTTPS URL; plain HTTP only for this machine in Test mode.

eventTypes.description: The event types it receives; none means all.

set.description: Whether the connection has a value.

last4.description: The last four characters of values long enough to keep them secret.

CredentialState.description: Whether a credential is set; credentials are never returned (SEC-9).

CustomerAddress.description: A billing address; `country` is ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, such as `TR`.

CustomerExportResponse.description: Everything Tahsil holds about a customer, for data subject requests (KVKK).

CustomerSnapshotResponse.description: The customer's billing details when the invoice was finalized.

price.description: A one-time price in the invoice's currency, by ID or lookup key.

unitAmount.description: Minor units, for lines without a price.

taxRate.description: For lines without a price: a tax rate by ID or key.

InvoiceLineRequest.description: A line to add: a one-time price, or a description with a unit amount (negative for a credit).

appliedBalance.description: The customer balance applied at finalization: positive when credit was spent, negative when a debt joined.

KimlikSubscriber.description: The Kimlik user or organization a customer is.

PayInvoiceRequest.description: Pays an invoice now with one of the customer's saved cards, off session.

PaymentMethodResponse.description: A saved card, with what may be shown about it; never card data.

reference.description: What the provider knows the payment by.

failureMessage.description: A message safe to show the customer.

PriceTier.description: A tier of a tiered price: units up to `upTo`, unbounded for the last tier.

ProviderCapabilitiesResponse.description: What a provider can do; values are snake_case names.

required.description: Whether a connection must have it.

description.description: Where to find the value, or what it changes.

default.description: The value when none is given.

ProviderFieldResponse.description: A credential or setting a provider's connections take.

ProviderResponse.description: A payment provider Tahsil has an adapter for.

meter.description: The meter's key, for metered prices.

ProvisionedPrice.description:
A price of the product. Only the name, trial, archive flag and metadata may change; a new amount is a new price with a
new key.

$schema.description: The JSON Schema editors use for completion and validation.

ProvisioningDocument.description:
What an installation sells, declared so it can live in version control and be applied the same way to every
environment. Items are matched by key; applying creates what is missing and updates what differs, and never deletes:
retire an item with `isArchived`.

ProvisioningResult.description: What applying a document did, or would do in a dry run.

UpdateConnectionRequest.description:
Changes a connection. Credentials and settings merge: the fields given replace the current values, the others stay;
an empty credential or a `null` setting removes an optional field. The key, provider and environment never change.

UpdateCustomerRequest.description: JSON Merge Patch: omitted fields stay as they are, `null` clears.

UpdateInvoiceRequest.description:
JSON Merge Patch. Drafts: the collection method, days until due, memo and metadata. Finalized invoices: only the
legal invoice and metadata.

transferKey.description: Moves string? UpdatePriceRequest.Key from the price that holds it to this one.

UpdatePriceRequest.description:
JSON Merge Patch of what may change: the lookup key, name, trial, archive flag and metadata. Anything else is
refused with `price.immutable`: a new amount is a new price.

isArchived.description: Archived products sell no more; existing subscriptions keep renewing.

UpdateProductRequest.description: JSON Merge Patch: omitted fields stay as they are, `null` clears.

UpdateSimulatorPaymentMethodRequest.description:
Test mode only: how a saved simulator card answers from now on (SIM-8): `succeed`, a failure code such as
`insufficient_funds`, `timeout_after_charge`, `timeout_before_charge` or `pending`.

UpdateTaxRateRequest.description: The percentage and inclusion never change; create a new rate instead.

UpdateWebhookEndpointRequest.description: JSON Merge Patch: omitted fields stay, `null` clears the description, and an empty list of event types means all.

WebhookSecretResponse.description: The new signing secret, shown only now; the previous one keeps signing until `previousSecretExpiresAt` (EVT-8).

ApiKey.description: An API key created in the admin panel or through the API, such as `ths_test_…`.
